title: Theme atelier
intro: A different writing space for every kind of story.
applied: Appearance applied. Check the settings status above for persistence.
noMatch: No matching themes. Clear the search or choose another collection.
previewExplanation: Rendered with the application's actual semantic tokens, title typography, corner shapes and shared components. Public sample content only; no manuscript, editor instance or model is loaded.
personalizeHelp: Changes preview immediately. Apply to save; cancel or close settings to restore your saved appearance.
contrastWarning: Text contrast is too low. Adjust the colors before applying (minimum 4.5 : 1).
fontHelp: Theme typography styles titles, chapter markers and decorative lettering. Your writing and interface font preferences remain in control; edit them below or under Writing.
exported: Non-sensitive theme settings exported; no manuscript or character assets.
imported: Imported into preview. Review and apply to save.
invalidImport: Import failed. Use a Novel Studio theme JSON smaller than 32 KB. Only built-in theme IDs and bounded appearance fields are accepted; scripts and external asset URLs are not allowed.
previewSafety: Previewing does not save manuscripts, reload the editor or start AI. Closing settings cancels unapplied appearance changes. Favorites save separately.
designNote: Artwork belongs in welcome areas and empty states. The writing page stays quiet. Reduced motion, focus mode and your decoration switch remain respected.
previewTitle: A page for the story still to come
previewProse: The wind outside grew quiet. She laid the letter beneath the lamp and read the first line again.
previewSecond: Some answers only appear as we keep writing.
description_moon: Warm white folios and deep teal; the familiar literary study.
description_mist: Soft green surfaces and clear space for long writing sessions.
description_night: A familiar low-light study with gentle, readable contrast.
description_amber: Warm pages and copper details, like a book by lamplight.
description_sky: Cool morning colors and light frames for a fresh page.
description_plum: Muted purple ink and a quiet glow for evening reading.
description_yoshino: Sakura paper and folded corners; private character resources stay separate.
description_rem: Clear blue, white and delicate lace; local character entry preserved.
description_rem-night: Deep blue and delicate light for readable nighttime writing.
description_manuscript: Engraved folios, leather spines and antique copper bookbinding.
description_ink: Xuan-paper space, expressive brush lines and distant mountains.
description_observatory: Orbital diagrams, silver markings and a deep blue observation window.
description_gothic: Pointed arches, rose-red shadows and copper-gold book frames.
description_cyber: Precise panels, fine grids and restrained cyan-violet illumination.
description_greenhouse: Glasshouse arches, botanical prints and a sunlit oak writing desk.
description_minimal: Monochrome order that lets the words take the lead.
projectThemeHelp: Give {{title}} its own theme while keeping writing, fonts and AI settings intact.
